item.title: Bristol–Uganda Collaborative Training Visit on Health Data Science
item.description: In June 2026, members of MIHRI (the Mayuge Institute for Global Health Sciences Research and Innovation) visited Bristol for Bristol Data Week. I prepared training materials for overall data science skills, including Git/GitHub and R, as well as probabilistic data linkage. You can find all of the materials in the following GitHub repository: https://github.com/babichmorrowc/bristol-uganda-data-week. If you have any questions about these resources, please let me know!

item.title: Brown Scholars Internship program
item.description: From 2018-2019, I taught programming skills to high school women. You can find a description of the internship and lesson plans I created in the following GitHub repository: https://github.com/babichmorrowc/SlothSquad2018-9. If you have any questions about these resources, please let me know!
